title: S3Location
description: Information about the location of training output or the output of a model packaging job.

allOf.description: The S3 bucket that contains the training or model packaging job output. If you are training a model, the bucket must in your AWS account. If you use an S3 bucket for a model packaging job, the S3 bucket must be in the same AWS Region and AWS account in which you use AWS IoT Greengrass.
The path of the folder, within the S3 bucket, that contains the output.
